Commit f35e840. Founder-authored script saved into episodes/nl01_never_land.md, TYLER own established episode format. Tyler + Hana reach a hidden subterranean Academy through a school building. Real, direct continuity link found and named: Hana and a hidden-school Custody Office already exist in episodes/s01e02_school.md (Build 0001) -- a real expansion of that premise, not invented here. Hana revealed as Handler Hana working a Custody chain; Tyler classified Green (spreads when witnessed). Sealed-room test passed via teleportation. Crow feathers behind a sealed corridor. Hana was sent to decide whether Tyler is a person or a resource. PAY WHAT YOU SAW note appears unattended. Episode closes on a shared vow to run if the debt forces the issue. Filed as its own named season (Series X own precedent) rather than a numbered S1-S11/current-timeline slot -- placement relative to Attempt Four vs Attempt Five left an open, founder-owned question. EPISODES.md/activity.md/CHANGELOG.md all updated.

⚓ ☃
